propositions: The Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on live navapbc/rebar tickets branch due to JQL parse error: 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"' is rejected by Jira because project LEG does not exist in live REB Jira Cloud.

The live .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG, ONE, TWO, ZERO) that do not exist in production, causing fetcher._build_snapshot to generate invalid queries for each nonexistent mapped key.

The multi-project fan-out in fetcher._build_snapshot iterates over all keys in read_projects() and issues jql_active(proj) for each; when the first key is invalid, ACLI exits 1 and the entire reconcile pass fails.

The corruption was introduced via ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch (authored with test-fixture identity) at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent failure, violating the concurrency invariant that all mutations must go through the unified store write lock and committed+published..
